digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and datetime/async compliance
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled in the global Ruff configuration and pass zero-diagnostic gate across src/rebar and tests.

Datetime timestamp semantics must be explicitly UTC: epoch integers converted with datetime.fromtimestamp(created, tz=timezone.utc) and timezone-less persisted strings assigned timezone.utc via strptime().replace().
Timezone-invariant epoch-to-UTC-hour-cluster behavior must be proven under at least two distinct TZ environment values using time.tzset() on supported POSIX/macOS platforms.
Security-pin cadence staleness decision must retain host-local calendar-date semantics by obtaining an aware instant with explicit tz argument, converting to host timezone, then extracting date.
All live ASYNC and DTZ diagnostics on current origin/main (including test-tree drift sites) must be resolved before the rule families are selected in pyproject.toml.
tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py must assert ASYNC/DTZ selection, absence of security selector S, absence of .semgrep configuration, and absence of the literal datetime.UTC token from production code.
